::: {#fig-box-chol-by-smoke}

```{r}
wcgs |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = smoke, y = chol, fill = smoke) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Current smoker", y = "Cholesterol (mg/dL)") +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "none")
```
